title: Bulls floater scoring leaders
subtitle: Top 15 in floaters made in one season, since 2015–16
scope: 2015–16 to 2025–26 regular season · Chicago games only
definition: NBA floating-shot labels, including driving and bank floaters. The driving labels begin in 2015–16.
relative_fg: rFG% = floater FG% minus that season’s NBA floater FG%, in percentage points.
shot_share: % OF FGA = floater attempts / all field-goal attempts in Bulls games.
